info.name: USHIKA WhatsApp Integration
info.description: Exercises the USHIKA backend: simulated Meta webhooks (signed), the REST API, and outbound sends. Start with '0. Setup > Obtain API token'. See docs/TESTING.md.

variable.description: Your verified test recipient, digits only

request.description: Exchanges a Django username/password for a DRF token and stores it in `api_token`.
Returns the user that `api_token` belongs to. 401 means the token is missing or invalid.

item.name: 1. Webhook (simulate Meta)
item.description: Requests here pretend to be Meta. POST bodies are signed by the folder's pre-request script with `app_secret`, which must equal WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET in the server's .env.

exec: // Fresh ids per request, so Meta-style events are never mistaken for duplicates.
// Sign POST bodies exactly as Meta does: HMAC-SHA256(raw body, app secret).
if (!secret) { console.warn('Set the app_secret collection variable to match WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET'); }

request.description: Creates an attachment and tries to download it from Meta. With a made-up media id the download fails and is recorded as `failed` - that is expected; use a real one from a live webhook to test downloads.
Fixed body. The first send returns {status: ok}; every later send returns {status: duplicate} and stores nothing new.
Uses `last_outbound_wamid`, set by '2. Messages > Send text message'.
Free-form text only works inside the 24-hour window after the customer last messaged you. Outside it, send a template (next request).

exec: pm.test('201 sent, or 502 if Meta rejected it', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 502]));
pm.test('201 sent, or 502 if Meta rejected it', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 502]));

request.description: Fixed idempotency_key: the second send returns 200 with the original record and does not call Meta again.
Use 'Send and Download' in Postman to save the file.

exec: pm.test('200 file, or 404 if not downloaded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]));

request.description: Fetches the file from WhatsApp and saves it to local storage; also retries a failed save. 403 when the contact's level does not allow it (images, PDFs) or you are not a superuser (other media).

exec: pm.test('200 saved, 403 not allowed, or 502 failed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 403, 502]));
